झोल म:म (Jhol Mo:Mo) 🥟 In Nepal, momo shops give you unlimited jhol to drown your momo in. This isn't some deep, intense achar. It's the jhol for a hungry tummy, the kind you keep asking for until your belly is full and happy. Toast soybeans and peanuts in a dry pan. Halfway through, add white sesame seeds, cumin seeds and timur. Keep moving it on low heat until everything turns brown and fragrant, then grind it into a fine powder. Soak lapsi powder in warm water. This is where the tang comes from. Sauté red onion and garlic in hot mustard oil with some ginger strips. On low heat, add chilli powder, turmeric, cumin powder, MSG and salt. Once the spices are bloomed, kill the heat and add cilantro stems. Blend everything with the lapsi water and the toasted powder. Thin with water in small batches, so it's runny but doesn't lose its flavour. Season with salt and finish with chopped cilantro leaves. Drown hot, juicy momo in it and enjoy. #NepaliFood #Momo #JholMomo #HimalayanFlavours #timur

November 14, 2026 Gorkha District, Nepal A large dry landslide occurred in Gorkha District. A mass of earth and rock collapsed from the Gundrung Pakha slope into the Thado Bharyang forest area near Yarubagar. Rocks began falling as early as Friday night, and the main landslide took place around 8:30 a.m., kicking up a massive cloud of dust. Debris reached the Budhi Gandaki River. The landslide blocked both a motorable road and a foot trail. According to the district police, there were no casualties or material damage.

The situation in Nepal remains devastating. The amount of mud and debris is overwhelming, and the work is challenging. But our team continues working alongside the local communities, doing everything we can to salvage as many belongings as possible from the rubble and disinfect homes to make them safe again. Sunita is one of the many homeowners our team has met along the way. She remains in her home, carefully cleaning, salvaging what is valuable to her, and gathering the belongings she hopes to recover. Every item saved is a little piece of her life and memories preserved. We’re still here doing our best to support as many families as possible.
